profile.headline: Software Engineer @ RentRedi
profile.summary:
🚀 Senior Software Engineer | Cloud Architect | Web & Mobile App Specialist

As a Senior Manager at AppWorld Infotech, I bring 10+ years of experience in cloud architecture, mobile app development, and performance optimization. I’ve led the development of large-scale, high-traffic platforms supporting 100K+ users, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.

🔹 Engineered a background notification system capable of sending 500K+ messages in under 5 minutes, complete with failure tracking and retry mechanisms.
🔹 Reduced query loading times from 2:30 minutes to just 30 seconds, optimizing database indexing and query logic.
🔹 Architected and deployed secure, serverless applications using AWS, Firebase, and GraphQL, aligning with ISO 27001 standards for security management.
🔹 Delivered 300+ cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter, Android SDK, and iOS, streamlining development and accelerating go-to-market timelines.
🔹 Collaborated with 30+ engineers across frontend, backend, QA, and DevOps to drive innovation and Agile delivery.

I’m passionate about building end-to-end software ecosystems that blend clean front-end user experiences with powerful, cloud-native backends.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead
positions.description:
I am an experienced professional with a proven track record in managing and optimizing large-scale systems. I have successfully handled the loading and optimization of databases for a high-traffic online inventory management system with over 100k users, ensuring efficient data management and consistent system performance.

One of my significant achievements was developing background utilities that efficiently sent 500k notifications within 5 minutes on both Android and iOS platforms. By implementing robust failure tracking and automated retry mechanisms, I ensured reliable notification delivery under high loads.

Additionally, I acquired the ISO 20007 certification for Security Management System, showcasing my expertise in implementing robust security protocols to safeguard user data and ensure secure operations.

In the cloud space, I have implemented and optimized solutions using Firebase for authentication, real-time database management, and serverless functions, ensuring scalability and high performance for large user bases.

I have hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS, working on configuring secure network environments by opening ports and applying best practices for firewall management and access control.

My domain management skills include seamless migrations of domains and hosting content between providers, ensuring minimal downtime and smooth transitions. Additionally, I have worked with Twilio to integrate phone authentication and SMS services, enhancing security and communication features within applications.

With a strong focus on system optimization, cloud-based solutions, and security management, I strive to deliver seamless and scalable solutions that improve user experience and business outcomes.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Over 2.5+ years of IT professional experience working in .Net, SQL server management & Windows.
•	Primarily used C# to write desktop applications.
•	Strong in communication, interpersonal, analytical and team building skills with proficiency of adopting new technical concept quickly and utilizing the same in Productive manner.
•	Communicated any issues with supervisor and participated in weekly meetings.
•	Developed ERP systems for diamond including inventory, stock handling,reorting,diamond pricing and allowing for customers to choose the customization to meet their individual needs
•	Worked as an integral part of the development team with troubleshooting development and maintenance of systems.
•	Worked with the development team to create appropriate cloud solutions for client needs.
•	Good knowledge of SDLC, Agile and Waterfall software development methodologies
•	Extensive experience to understand client requirement and code the same as per client expectation.
positions.insights: C#, Microsoft SQL Server and +3 skills
